name: Mechatronics
summary: Mechanics, electronics and software taught as one subject, because that is how robots, automated production lines and medical devices are actually built. You get a broad toolbox — mechanics, electronics, programming, power electronics, thermodynamics, data-driven methods — and spend a lot of time on problems brought in from industry.

family.name: Mechatronics
family.differs: 3 years, research-based, and leads straight into the MSc in Engineering. No internship.
